title: Does anyone else experience an old crumbling mansion within a pristine mansion?
content: I frequently return to a mansion in my dreams that is beautiful and in pristine condition on the outside, but once I enter through a specific door it becomes the exact same interior of the mansion only older, dark and decayed. I first discovered this secret room that led to the “dark” version of the mansion, and since discovering it many years ago, if I have other people in the dream I am adamant on showing them the secret side of the mansion. Like all I can think about/ want to do is show them it. Has anyone dreamt of a similar place? Oh also hella waterpark dreams What’s up with that
